newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech economy can accept larger trade gap - Tosovsky.
newsitem.headline: Czech economy can accept larger trade gap - Tosovsky.

text.p: The Czech economy has the capacity to withstand a larger trade deficit over the medium-term, central bank Governor Josef Tosovsky said on Wednesday.
"The Czech Republic in the medium term can afford a higher deficit in its trade balance and current account, more than in other economies," Tosovsky said in a speech to a business forum.
He said this was due to strong foreign exchange reserves and its low level of indebtedness.
However, he said investors get nervous when the current account deficit passes the 4-5 percent range of GDP, adding that it could pass 6 percent of GDP by year's end.
